summary: Session-revocation security phase tested. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_auth_sessions.py covering change-password (auth guard, wrong current, <8 char, same-as-current, success + old-token 401 'Sessão revogada'), logout-all-devices (revokes prior token, reissues), admin/users/{id}/force-logout (admin-only 403 for user, bumps sv, kills victim's token), admin/users/{id}/reset-password (admin-only, <8 rejected, hashes new pw + bumps sv + old token dead + old pw fails + new pw works), sv claim comparison, /auth/me + /admin/users regression. Estoque regression 12/12 pass. Frontend: /configuracoes route + SettingsPage fully wired to backend (verified in-browser with sandbox admin: all 7 data-testids present, wrong-current-password toast 'Senha atual incorreta' surfaces correctly). Sidebar nav-configuracoes visible. CRITICAL FRONTEND MISS: AdminUsuariosPage.jsx does NOT contain the required admin-force-logout-{id} or admin-reset-pass-{id} buttons — the imports (LogOut, KeyRound), handlers (forceLogout, resetPassword) and buttons are entirely absent though the review request lists them as required.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing admin-force-logout-{id} and admin-reset-pass-{id} buttons per user. LogOut/KeyRound icons not imported, forceLogout/resetPassword handlers not implemented. Only Permissões/Aprovar/Rejeitar/Delete buttons exist. Backend endpoints (/api/admin/users/{id}/force-logout and /reset-password) work — admin cannot invoke them from UI.

action_items: Add admin-force-logout-{id} and admin-reset-pass-{id} buttons to AdminUsuariosPage.jsx as specified in the review request. Import LogOut and KeyRound from lucide-react. Implement forceLogout(u) → confirm dialog → POST /api/admin/users/{u.id}/force-logout. Implement resetPassword(u) → prompt for new pw with min-8 validation → POST /api/admin/users/{u.id}/reset-password with { new_password }. Show these buttons in the per-user actions row (probably alongside admin-delete-{id}).

Optional: The pytest test file must be run with -n 1 (single worker) because it mutates the sandbox admin's password/session_version. If run in parallel via xdist, TestChangePasswordFlow races with TestLogoutAllDevices/TestRegression using the same sandbox account. Consider adding to pytest.ini or documenting.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 4000 lines — long overdue for splitting into routers (auth, admin, projects, estoque, faturamento, etc.). Not blocking this phase.

Backend correctly refuses same-as-current password with 400 (good), but the error message ('Nova senha deve ser diferente da atual') isn't in the review's expected asserts — assertion is satisfied since it returns 400.
Backend uses `int(user.get('session_version', 0) or 0)` defensively everywhere — good, correctly treats missing sv on legacy tokens as 0.
seed_admin backfill uses update_many with $exists:false — idempotent, safe.

SettingsPage persists returned access_token to localStorage. However axios in this project appears to use cookies (httpOnly) as primary auth per login flow; storing access_token in localStorage may not actually be used for subsequent requests unless a request interceptor picks it up. Not blocking (backend still recognises via httpOnly cookies which were also refreshed) but worth confirming.
AdminUsuariosPage: no per-user permission list is fetched fresh after Update — relies on full re-fetch (ok). No admin-force-logout / admin-reset-pass buttons — see action item.
